svg.aria-label: Animated Section 3.3 mechanism window: SPSA damps the amplitude

g.text: Why averaging can win: SPSA damps the window amplitude
Six test points inside the final learning-rate cycle · y is AUC − the window’s own mean, in points · one shared y-axis, so the amplitudes are drawn to the same scale
● θend, the endpoint · ○ θ̄, the SWA average · the bar between them is Δ = Bonus − Dev · dashed line = the window’s own mean
probes 1–6 are test points at steps 18182, 19139, 20096, 21053, 22010, 22967 (≈957 apart)
θ̄ read from swa_eval.jsonl with the BatchNorm buffers re-estimated: the Section 3.3 convention
